title: Bot-team shared feed line
description: One JSON object per line in .estate/feed.jsonl. Every bot reads and writes the same feed; hand-offs happen here, not in private chats.

ts.description: ISO 8601 time; the writer sets it when the caller does not.

agent.description: Persona that wrote the line (KAR, BUILDER, MONEY TIME, REACH, SCOUT, CLIENT LEAD, CARD KEEPER, AUDITOR).

what.description: Plain-language action. Every string in the line, at any depth (nested fields and lists included), is redacted for keys, tokens, passwords, emails and card numbers before it reaches disk.

link.description: Proof or artifact: an http(s) URL, a repository path or a file name. Free text such as "see above" is not proof.

needs_owner.description: Next persona to act (hand-off), or 'Simon' when it needs his signature.

receipt_sha256.description: Hash of the re-runnable receipt. A done claim (a done-word that is not negated, or kind build / receipt) with no receipt and no proof link is auto-flagged.

flags.description: Set by the feed writer, e.g. done-without-receipt. Flags a caller sets are ignored and recomputed.
